item.title: fix(install): reject invalid PowerShell installer options (#124882)
item.summary: fix(install): reject invalid PowerShell installer options (#124882) * fix(install): reject invalid PowerShell installer options Bind installer parameters strictly so unknown switches and positional arguments cannot enter the mutating installer body. Validate environment options before initialization, add explicit help, and gate website publication on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh probes.
